## Summary

Describe the user-visible behavior and why the change is needed.

## Privacy and performance

State whether permissions, provider traffic, stored data, cache size, DOM scanning, or memory behavior changed.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] Relevant manual Firefox or Chrome verification
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, captured pages, generated builds, or browser profiles added

Include screenshots or a short recording for popup, settings, page animation, or other visual changes.
